top_signals.title: Ken Griffin says Citadel unwound more than 80% of risk tied to Situational Awareness portfolio
top_signals.summary: Citadel has unwound more than 80% of the portfolio risk it acquired from Situational Awareness through over $4 billion in block trades, said Ken Griffin.

top_signals.title: Millennials Feel Good About Their Finances, the Data Show Why
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Sarah Foster joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." Almost half of US millennials say their financial situation has improved from five years ago. That compares with 43% of Generation X and 40% of baby boomers who say the same. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises, 2024
top_signals.summary: Majority-owned U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises employed 8.57 million workers in the United States in 2024, a 0.2 percent increase from 8.56 million workers in 2023, according to statistics on U.S. affiliate operations and finances released today by the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis. top_signals.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
top_signals.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
